item.title: Trim trends buyers keep asking about
item.description:
This is a studio note, not a forecast. TrimGem University is for constructions and tests. Once a year we write down what buyers have actually been asking the Guangzhou table to quote. Trade-press market sizes (global accessories in the hundreds of billions of dollars, recycled-button penetration, RFID unit counts) move with the slide deck; we do not repeat them as our own facts.

TrimGem is a Guangzhou one-stop accessories house. The catalogue will keep expanding — zippers, labels, RFID, prints, membranes, hi-vis tapes — and this page is what the sample table has been asked to quote, not a market-size slide.

item.title: What we have been sampling in the Guangzhou studio
item.description:
TrimGem University is the spec library for the accessory families we sell now and the ones we add next. This page is only a shorter note from the sampling table — what buyers have asked us to quote since last autumn — not a forecast and not the full university map.

Lace

Ready-to-wear teams still want narrow Raschel galloons with a clean eyelash and a stated stretch. Bridal teams still want chemical-lace motifs and heavier embroidered edges, then discover the metre price when the dress is a 200-piece run. We have been pushing the construction name onto the first swatch card so that conversation happens before the PPS.
